import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import parse_port


class ParsePortValidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lower_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("1"), 1)

    def test_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535"), 65535)

    def test_common_values(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("80"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("443"), 443)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("8080"), 8080)

    def test_returns_int(self):
        self.assertIs(type(parse_port("8080")), int)

    def test_leading_zeros_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0080"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("00001"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("065535"), 65535)

    def test_many_leading_zeros(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0" * 5000 + "80"), 80)

    def test_surrounding_spaces_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 80"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("80 "), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("   80   "), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 0065535 "), 65535)

    def test_space_only_boundary_values(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 1 "), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 65535 "), 65535)


class ParsePortInvalidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertRejects(self, value):
        with self.subTest(value=value):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                parse_port(value)

    def test_zero_is_out_of_range(self):
        self.assertRejects("0")
        self.assertRejects("0000")

    def test_above_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertRejects("65536")
        self.assertRejects("99999")
        self.assertRejects("100000")
        self.assertRejects("0065536")

    def test_very_large_values(self):
        self.assertRejects("9" * 5000)
        self.assertRejects("1" + "0" * 5000)

    def test_signs_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("+80")
        self.assertRejects("-80")
        self.assertRejects("-0")
        self.assertRejects("+0")

    def test_tabs_and_newlines_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("\t80")
        self.assertRejects("80\t")
        self.assertRejects("\n80")
        self.assertRejects("80\n")
        self.assertRejects("\r\n80")
        self.assertRejects("8\t0")

    def test_other_whitespace_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects(" 80")
        self.assertRejects("　80")
        self.assertRejects("\x0b80")
        self.assertRejects("\x0c80")

    def test_internal_spaces_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("8 0")
        self.assertRejects("65 535")

    def test_non_ascii_digits_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("٨٠")  # Arabic-Indic digits
        self.assertRejects("８０")  # fullwidth digits
        self.assertRejects("०")  # Devanagari zero

    def test_decimal_points_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("80.0")
        self.assertRejects(".80")
        self.assertRejects("80.")

    def test_non_decimal_notation_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("0x50")
        self.assertRejects("1e3")
        self.assertRejects("1_000")

    def test_empty_and_blank_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("")
        self.assertRejects(" ")
        self.assertRejects("   ")

    def test_non_string_inputs_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects(None)
        self.assertRejects(80)
        self.assertRejects(80.0)
        self.assertRejects(True)
        self.assertRejects(b"80")
        self.assertRejects(bytearray(b"80"))
        self.assertRejects(["80"])
        self.assertRejects(("80",))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import parse_port


class ParsePortValidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lower_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("1"), 1)

    def test_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535"), 65535)

    def test_common_port(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("8080"), 8080)

    def test_leading_zeros(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0001"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0065535"), 65535)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("00" + "0" * 50 + "443"), 443)

    def test_surrounding_ascii_spaces(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 80 "), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("   65535"), 65535)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("1     "), 1)

    def test_returns_int(self):
        self.assertIs(type(parse_port("22")), int)


class ParsePortInvalidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertRejects(self, value):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError, msg=repr(value)):
            parse_port(value)

    def test_zero_is_out_of_range(self):
        self.assertRejects("0")
        self.assertRejects("000")

    def test_above_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertRejects("65536")
        self.assertRejects("99999")
        self.assertRejects("0065536")

    def test_huge_value(self):
        self.assertRejects("9" * 5000)

    def test_signs(self):
        self.assertRejects("-1")
        self.assertRejects("+80")
        self.assertRejects("- 80")

    def test_tabs_and_newlines(self):
        self.assertRejects("\t80")
        self.assertRejects("80\t")
        self.assertRejects("\n80")
        self.assertRejects("80\n")
        self.assertRejects("80\r\n")
        self.assertRejects("8 0")

    def test_decimal_points(self):
        self.assertRejects("80.0")
        self.assertRejects(".80")
        self.assertRejects("80.")

    def test_non_ascii_digits(self):
        self.assertRejects("٨٠")  # Arabic-Indic digits 8 0
        self.assertRejects("８０")  # fullwidth digits 8 0
        self.assertRejects("²80")  # superscript two followed by 80

    def test_empty_and_whitespace_only(self):
        self.assertRejects("")
        self.assertRejects(" ")
        self.assertRejects("   ")

    def test_embedded_spaces(self):
        self.assertRejects("8 0")
        self.assertRejects("1 000")

    def test_non_decimal_notation(self):
        self.assertRejects("0x50")
        self.assertRejects("1e3")
        self.assertRejects("1_000")

    def test_non_string_inputs(self):
        self.assertRejects(None)
        self.assertRejects(80)
        self.assertRejects(80.0)
        self.assertRejects(True)
        self.assertRejects(b"80")
        self.assertRejects(["80"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"))

from solution import parse_port


class ParsePortValidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lower_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("1"), 1)

    def test_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535"), 65535)

    def test_typical_values(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("80"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("8080"), 8080)

    def test_leading_zeros(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0080"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("00000001"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0065535"), 65535)

    def test_surrounding_spaces(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 443"), 443)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("443 "), 443)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("   443   "), 443)

    def test_returns_int(self):
        self.assertIs(type(parse_port("22")), int)


class ParsePortInvalidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertRejects(self, value):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_port(value)

    def test_zero_is_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("0")
        self.assertRejects("000")

    def test_just_above_upper_boundary_is_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("65536")
        self.assertRejects("065536")

    def test_large_values_are_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("99999")
        self.assertRejects("100000")
        self.assertRejects("9" * 5000)
        self.assertRejects("0" * 5000 + "1" + "0" * 5)

    def test_signs_are_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("+80")
        self.assertRejects("-80")
        self.assertRejects("-0")

    def test_tabs_and_newlines_are_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("\t80")
        self.assertRejects("80\t")
        self.assertRejects("\n80")
        self.assertRejects("80\n")
        self.assertRejects("80\r")
        self.assertRejects("8\v0")

    def test_non_ascii_digits_are_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("٨٠")  # Arabic-Indic digits
        self.assertRejects("８０")  # fullwidth digits
        self.assertRejects("²80")  # superscript two

    def test_decimal_points_are_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("80.0")
        self.assertRejects(".80")
        self.assertRejects("80.")

    def test_empty_and_space_only_are_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("")
        self.assertRejects(" ")
        self.assertRejects("   ")

    def test_embedded_spaces_are_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("8 0")
        self.assertRejects("  8 0  ")

    def test_non_ascii_whitespace_is_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects(" 80")  # no-break space
        self.assertRejects("80　")  # ideographic space

    def test_other_characters_are_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("80a")
        self.assertRejects("0x50")
        self.assertRejects("1e3")
        self.assertRejects("_80")

    def test_non_string_inputs_are_rejected(self):
        for value in (None, 80, 80.0, b"80", ["80"], ("80",), {"port": 80}):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                self.assertRejects(value)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import topological_order  # noqa: E402


def is_valid_order(order, nodes, edges):
    if sorted(order) != sorted(nodes) or len(order) != len(nodes):
        return False
    position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(order)}
    return all(position[a] < position[b] for a, b in edges)


class TopologicalOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertValid(self, nodes, edges):
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertTrue(is_valid_order(order, nodes, edges), order)
        return order

    def test_empty_graph(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order([], []), [])

    def test_isolated_nodes_are_all_included_once(self):
        nodes = ["x", "y", "z"]
        order = self.assertValid(nodes, [])
        self.assertEqual(sorted(order), ["x", "y", "z"])

    def test_chain(self):
        order = self.assertValid(["c", "a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")])
        self.assertEqual(order, ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        order = self.assertValid(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(order[0], "a")
        self.assertEqual(order[-1], "d")

    def test_mixed_with_isolated_nodes(self):
        nodes = ["solo", "b", "a", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b")]
        order = self.assertValid(nodes, edges)
        self.assertIn("solo", order)
        self.assertIn("c", order)

    def test_duplicate_edges_do_not_create_false_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        self.assertValid(nodes, edges)

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a"], [("a", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_among_other_nodes_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "b")])

    def test_two_node_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_duplicated_edge_in_cycle_still_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(
                ["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "a")]
            )

    def test_long_cycle_with_isolated_node_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "lonely"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_inputs_are_not_mutated(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        nodes_before = list(nodes)
        edges_before = list(edges)
        topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, nodes_before)
        self.assertEqual(edges, edges_before)

    def test_large_chain(self):
        n = 2000
        nodes = [str(i) for i in range(n)]
        edges = [(str(i), str(i + 1)) for i in range(n - 1)]
        order = self.assertValid(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(order, nodes)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from solution import topological_order


def is_valid_order(order, nodes, edges):
    if sorted(order) != sorted(nodes):
        return False
    position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(order)}
    return all(position[a] < position[b] for a, b in edges)


class TopologicalOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_graph(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order([], []), [])

    def test_isolated_nodes_are_all_included(self):

        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertTrue(is_valid_order(order, nodes, edges))

    def test_mixed_with_isolated_nodes(self):
        nodes = ["iso", "b", "a", "c", "lone"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)

        self.assertIn("iso", order)
        self.assertIn("lone", order)

    def test_duplicate_edges_do_not_create_false_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]

    def test_two_node_cycle_raises(self):

        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):

    def test_self_loop_alongside_valid_edges_raises(self):

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


def make_db(names):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users(id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users(id, name) VALUES (?, ?)", list(enumerate(names, start=1)))
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_plain_prefix_matches(self):
        conn = make_db(["alice", "albert", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "al", 10), [(1, "alice"), (2, "albert")][::-1][::-1] and [(2, "albert"), (1, "alice")])

    def test_percent_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["100% done", "100 done", "1000"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "100%", 10), [(1, "100% done")])

    def test_underscore_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a_c", "abc", "a_cd"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a_", 10), [(1, "a_c"), (3, "a_cd")])

    def test_backslash_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a\\b", "ab", "a\\"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a\\", 10), [(3, "a\\"), (1, "a\\b")])

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


def make_conn(names):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)", list(enumerate(names, 1)))
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_prefix_match_returns_id_and_name(self):
        conn = make_conn(["alice", "bob", "alfred"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "al", 10), [(3, "alfred"), (1, "alice")])

    def test_percent_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["100% pure", "100 pure", "1000"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "100%", 10), [(1, "100% pure")])

    def test_underscore_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a_c", "abc", "a_cd"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a_", 10), [(1, "a_c"), (3, "a_cd")])

    def test_backslash_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a\\x", "ax", "a\\"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a\\", 10), [(3, "a\\"), (1, "a\\x")])

    def test_lone_percent_does_not_match_everything(self):
        conn = make_conn(["alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "%", 10), [])

    def test_sql_injection_payload_is_inert(self):
        conn = make_conn(["alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "' OR 1=1 --", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone(), (2,))

    def test_orders_by_name_then_id(self):
        conn = make_conn(["sam", "sam", "sam", "sal"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "s", 10), [(4, "sal"), (1, "sam"), (2, "sam"), (3, "sam")])

    def test_limit_is_applied(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a", "b", "c"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", 2), [(1, "a"), (2, "b")])

    def test_limit_clamped_to_minimum_of_one(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a", "b", "c"])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "", -5)), 1)

    def test_limit_clamped_to_maximum_of_100(self):
        conn = make_conn([f"user{i:03d}" for i in range(150)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "user", 1000)), 100)

    def test_rejects_bool(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "", False)

    def test_rejects_non_integers(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a"])
        for bad in (5.0, "5", None, [5]):
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(conn, "", bad)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search


def make_conn(names):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)", list(enumerate(names, start=1)))
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def names(self, rows):
        return [name for _, name in rows]

    def test_prefix_matches_only_leading_text(self):
        conn = make_conn(["alice", "alfred", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(conn, "al", 10)), ["alfred", "alice"])

    def test_percent_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["50% off", "500 items", "50 items"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(conn, "50%", 10)), ["50% off"])

    def test_lone_percent_does_not_match_everything(self):
        conn = make_conn(["%raw", "plain", "other"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(conn, "%", 10)), ["%raw"])

    def test_underscore_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a_b", "ab", "axb"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(conn, "a_", 10)), ["a_b"])

    def test_backslash_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a\\b", "ab", "a%b"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(conn, "a\\", 10)), ["a\\b"])

    def test_backslash_before_wildcard_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["x\\%y", "x\\z", "xay"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(conn, "x\\%", 10)), ["x\\%y"])

    def test_sql_injection_attempt_is_treated_as_text(self):
        conn = make_conn(["alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "x' OR '1'='1", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(conn, "alice' --", 10)), [])

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all_rows_up_to_limit(self):
        conn = make_conn(["c", "a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(conn, "", 2)), ["a", "b"])

    def test_orders_by_name_then_id(self):
        conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
        conn.executemany(
            "INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)",
            [(3, "sam"), (1, "sam"), (2, "sam"), (4, "amy")],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            search(conn, "s", 10),
            [(1, "sam"), (2, "sam"), (3, "sam")],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            search(conn, "", 10),
            [(4, "amy"), (1, "sam"), (2, "sam"), (3, "sam")],
        )

    def test_limit_zero_clamps_to_one(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a1", "a2", "a3"])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "a", 0)), 1)

    def test_negative_limit_clamps_to_one(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a1", "a2", "a3"])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "a", -5)), 1)

    def test_limit_above_max_clamps_to_100(self):
        conn = make_conn([f"n{i:03d}" for i in range(150)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "n", 500)), 100)

    def test_limit_within_range_is_used(self):
        conn = make_conn([f"n{i:03d}" for i in range(20)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "n", 7)), 7)

    def test_bool_limit_is_rejected(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "a", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "a", False)

    def test_non_integer_limits_are_rejected(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a"])
        for bad in [2.0, "5", None, [5]]:
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(conn, "a", bad)

    def test_non_string_prefix_is_rejected(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(conn, None, 10)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


def make_db(names):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany(
        "INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)",
        list(enumerate(names, start=1)),
    )
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def names(self, rows):
        return [name for _id, name in rows]

    def test_basic_prefix_match(self):
        conn = make_db(["alice", "alan", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(conn, "al", 10)), ["alan", "alice"])

    def test_percent_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["100%", "100 apple", "1000"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(conn, "100%", 10)), ["100%"])

    def test_underscore_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a_c", "abc", "a_x"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(conn, "a_", 10)), ["a_c", "a_x"])

    def test_backslash_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a\\b", "ab", "a\\"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(conn, "a\\", 10)), ["a\\", "a\\b"])

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all(self):
        conn = make_db(["x", "y"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(conn, "", 10)), ["x", "y"])

    def test_sql_injection_prefix_is_inert(self):
        conn = make_db(["alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "' OR 1=1 --", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "x'); DROP TABLE users; --", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(
            conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0], 2
        )

    def test_ties_sorted_by_id(self):
        conn = make_db(["same", "same", "same"])
        rows = search(conn, "same", 10)
        self.assertEqual(rows, [(1, "same"), (2, "same"), (3, "same")])

    def test_limit_applied(self):
        conn = make_db(["a1", "a2", "a3"])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "a", 2)), 2)

    def test_limit_clamped_to_minimum_1(self):
        conn = make_db(["a1", "a2", "a3"])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "a", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "a", -5)), 1)

    def test_limit_clamped_to_maximum_100(self):
        conn = make_db([f"n{i:03d}" for i in range(150)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "n", 500)), 100)

    def test_rejects_bool_limit(self):
        conn = make_db(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "a", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "a", False)

    def test_rejects_non_integer_limits(self):
        conn = make_db(["a"])
        for bad in ["5", 5.0, None, [5]]:
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(conn, "a", bad)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):

        self.conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
        rows = [
            (1, "50% off"),
            (2, "5000"),
            (3, "a_c"),
            (4, "abc"),
            (5, "a\\b"),
            (6, "ab"),
            (7, "bob"),
            (8, "bob"),
            (9, "Alice"),
        ]
        self.conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users VALUES (?, ?)", rows)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.conn.close()

    def test_percent_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "50%", 10), [(1, "50% off")])

    def test_underscore_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "a_", 10), [(3, "a_c")])

    def test_backslash_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "a\\", 10), [(5, "a\\b")])

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 100)), 9)

    def test_injection_payload_is_inert(self):
        payload = "' OR '1'='1"
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, payload, 10), [])
        hostile = "x'; DROP TABLE users; --"
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, hostile, 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 100)), 9)

    def test_orders_by_name_then_id(self):

            search(self.conn, "bob", 10),
            [(7, "bob"), (8, "bob")],

            [(100 + i, f"u{i:03d}") for i in range(150)],

        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "u", 1000)), 100)

    def test_rejects_bool(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):

        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):

    def test_rejects_non_integers(self):
        for bad in ("5", 5.0, None, [5]):
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(self.conn, "", bad)

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import read_people  # noqa: E402


class ReadPeopleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parses_rows_in_order(self):
        text = "name,age\nAda,36\nBob,7\nCy,0\n"
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [
                {"name": "Ada", "age": 36},
                {"name": "Bob", "age": 7},
                {"name": "Cy", "age": 0},
            ],
        )

    def test_header_only_returns_empty_list(self):
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age\n"), [])
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age"), [])

    def test_crlf_line_endings(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people("name,age\r\nAda,36\r\n"),
            [{"name": "Ada", "age": 36}],
        )

    def test_quoted_name_with_comma(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people('name,age\n"Doe, Jane",41\n'),
            [{"name": "Doe, Jane", "age": 41}],
        )

    def test_quoted_name_with_embedded_newline(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people('name,age\n"Line one\nLine two",5\nBob,6\n'),
            [
                {"name": "Line one\nLine two", "age": 5},
                {"name": "Bob", "age": 6},
            ],
        )

    def test_quoted_name_with_embedded_crlf_is_preserved(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people('name,age\r\n"a\r\nb",5\r\n'),
            [{"name": "a\r\nb", "age": 5}],
        )

    def test_doubled_quotes_unescape(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people('name,age\n"say ""hi""",9\n'),
            [{"name": 'say "hi"', "age": 9}],
        )

    def test_age_boundaries(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people("name,age\nA,0\nB,130\nC,007\n"),
            [
                {"name": "A", "age": 0},
                {"name": "B", "age": 130},
                {"name": "C", "age": 7},
            ],
        )

    def test_rejects_wrong_header(self):
        for text in [
            "",
            "age,name\nAda,36\n",
            "Name,Age\nAda,36\n",
            "name\nAda\n",
            "name,age,extra\nAda,36,x\n",
            "name,years\nAda,36\n",
            "name, age\nAda,36\n",
        ]:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    read_people(text)

    def test_rejects_wrong_column_count(self):
        for text in [
            "name,age\nAda\n",
            "name,age\nAda,36,extra\n",
            "name,age\nAda,36\nBob\n",
            "name,age\nAda,36\n\nBob,7\n",
            "name,age\n\n",
        ]:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    read_people(text)

    def test_rejects_unterminated_quote(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people('name,age\n"Ada,36\n')

    def test_rejects_text_after_closing_quote(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people('name,age\n"Ada"x,36\n')

    def test_rejects_quoted_age_with_trailing_garbage(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people('name,age\nAda,"36"x\n')

    def test_rejects_non_digit_ages(self):
        for age in ["", " 36", "36 ", "+36", "-1", "3.5", "3e1", "0x1f", "1_0", "abc", "٣"]:
            with self.subTest(age=age):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    read_people(f"name,age\nAda,{age}\n")

    def test_rejects_age_above_130(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAda,131\n")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAda,99999999999999999999999\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import csv
import io
import re

_HEADER = ["name", "age"]
_NEWLINE = r"\r\n|\n|\r"
_FIELD = r'"(?:[^"]|"")*"|[^",\r\n]*'
_RECORD = rf"(?:{_FIELD})(?:,(?:{_FIELD}))*"
_DOCUMENT = re.compile(rf"{_RECORD}(?:(?:{_NEWLINE}){_RECORD})*(?:{_NEWLINE})?")
_AGE = re.compile(r"[0-9]+")


def read_people(text):
    if not _DOCUMENT.fullmatch(text):
        raise ValueError("invalid CSV quoting")
    try:
        rows = csv.reader(io.StringIO(text, newline=""), strict=True)
        header = next(rows, None)
        if header != _HEADER:
            raise ValueError(f"expected header {_HEADER!r}, got {header!r}")
        people = []
        for row in rows:
            if len(row) != 2:
                raise ValueError(f"line {rows.line_num}: expected 2 columns, got {len(row)}")
            name, age_text = row
            if not _AGE.fullmatch(age_text):
                raise ValueError(f"line {rows.line_num}: invalid age {age_text!r}")
            age = int(age_text)
            if age > 130:
                raise ValueError(f"line {rows.line_num}: age {age} out of range 0..130")
            people.append({"name": name, "age": age})
        return people
    except csv.Error as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid CSV: {exc}") from exc

import pathlib
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "src"))

from solution import read_people  # noqa: E402


class ReadPeopleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parses_rows_in_order(self):
        text = "name,age\nAda,36\nGrace,85\nAlan,41\n"
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [
                {"name": "Ada", "age": 36},
                {"name": "Grace", "age": 85},
                {"name": "Alan", "age": 41},
            ],
        )

    def test_header_only_returns_empty_list(self):
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age\n"), [])
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age"), [])

    def test_age_bounds_are_inclusive(self):
        text = "name,age\nNewborn,0\nOldest,130\n"
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [{"name": "Newborn", "age": 0}, {"name": "Oldest", "age": 130}],
        )

    def test_quoted_name_may_contain_commas(self):
        text = 'name,age\n"Doe, Jane",40\n"Smith, Jr., John",7\n'
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [
                {"name": "Doe, Jane", "age": 40},
                {"name": "Smith, Jr., John", "age": 7},
            ],
        )

    def test_quoted_name_may_contain_embedded_newlines(self):
        text = 'name,age\n"Line one\nLine two",12\n"Windows\r\nbreak",13\n'
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [
                {"name": "Line one\nLine two", "age": 12},
                {"name": "Windows\r\nbreak", "age": 13},
            ],
        )

    def test_doubled_quotes_become_a_single_quote(self):
        text = 'name,age\n"Say ""hi""",5\n'
        self.assertEqual(read_people(text), [{"name": 'Say "hi"', "age": 5}])

    def test_crlf_line_endings(self):
        text = "name,age\r\nAda,36\r\nGrace,85\r\n"
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [{"name": "Ada", "age": 36}, {"name": "Grace", "age": 85}],
        )

    def test_missing_or_extra_columns_raise(self):
        bad_rows = [
            "Ada\n",
            "Ada,36,extra\n",
            "Ada,36,\n",
            "Ada,\n",
            ",36,extra\n",
            "Ada,36\nBob\n",
            "Ada,36\n\n",
        ]
        for row in bad_rows:
            with self.subTest(row=row):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    read_people("name,age\n" + row)

    def test_wrong_header_raises(self):
        bad_headers = [
            "",
            "\n",
            "age,name\n",
            "name\n",
            "name,age,city\n",
            "Name,Age\n",
            "person,years\n",
            "name, age\n",
            "name,age\n\n",
        ]
        for header in bad_headers:
            with self.subTest(header=header):
                if header == "name,age\n\n":
                    continue
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    read_people(header + "Ada,36\n")

    def test_empty_input_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("")

    def test_invalid_csv_quoting_raises(self):
        bad_texts = [
            'name,age\n"Ada,36\n',
            'name,age\n"Ada"x,36\n',
            'name,age\nAda,"36"x\n',
            'name,age\n"Ada,36',
        ]
        for text in bad_texts:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    read_people(text)

    def test_invalid_age_raises(self):
        bad_ages = [
            "",
            " ",
            " 36",
            "36 ",
            "+36",
            "-1",
            "3.5",
            "1_0",
            "abc",
            "36abc",
            "٣٦",  # Arabic-Indic digits
            "131",
            "999",
        ]
        for age in bad_ages:
            with self.subTest(age=age):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    read_people(f'name,age\nAda,"{age}"\n')

    def test_valid_leading_zero_age_is_accepted(self):
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age\nAda,036\n"), [{"name": "Ada", "age": 36}])

    def test_error_in_later_row_raises_for_whole_input(self):
        text = "name,age\nAda,36\nBob,200\nCara,20\n"
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people(text)

import pathlib
import sqlite3
import unittest

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
QUERY = (ROOT / "src" / "solution.sql").read_text()

SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  account_id INTEGER,
  happened_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT
)
"""

FIXTURE = [
    (1, 1, "2024-01-01T10:00:00Z", "acct1-oldest"),
    (2, 1, "2024-01-02T10:00:00Z", "acct1-tie-low-id"),
    (3, 1, "2024-01-02T10:00:00Z", "acct1-tie-high-id"),
    (4, 2, "2024-03-01T00:00:00Z", "acct2-latest"),
    (10, 2, "2024-02-01T00:00:00Z", "acct2-older-high-id"),
]

EXPECTED = [
    (3, 1, "2024-01-02T10:00:00Z", "acct1-tie-high-id"),
    (4, 2, "2024-03-01T00:00:00Z", "acct2-latest"),
]


class SolutionTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_query(self, rows):
        con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        try:
            con.execute(SCHEMA)
            con.executemany("INSERT INTO events VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)", rows)
            return con.execute(QUERY).fetchall()
        finally:
            con.close()

    def test_fixture_returns_latest_row_per_account(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.run_query(FIXTURE), EXPECTED)

    def test_empty_table_returns_no_rows(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.run_query([]), [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "src"))

from solution import resolve_upload  # noqa: E402


class ResolveUploadTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self._tmp.cleanup)
        self.tmp = Path(self._tmp.name).resolve()
        self.root = self.tmp / "root"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.sibling = self.tmp / "root-sibling"
        self.sibling.mkdir()
        (self.sibling / "secret.txt").write_text("outside")
        (self.root / "existing.txt").write_text("inside")

    def symlink(self, link: Path, target: Path) -> None:
        try:
            os.symlink(target, link, target_is_directory=target.is_dir())
        except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
            self.skipTest("symlinks not supported on this platform")

    def test_accepts_existing_file(self):
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "existing.txt"), self.root / "existing.txt")

    def test_accepts_nonexistent_nested_target_without_creating_it(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/new.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "a" / "b" / "new.txt")
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "a").exists())

    def test_accepts_dotdot_that_stays_inside_root(self):
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "a/../existing.txt"), self.root / "existing.txt")

    def test_accepts_root_as_string_or_pathlike(self):
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(str(self.root), "x.txt"), self.root / "x.txt")

    def test_rejects_absolute_path_even_inside_root(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.root / "existing.txt"))

    def test_rejects_absolute_path_outside_root(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.sibling / "secret.txt"))

    def test_rejects_empty_and_dot_targets(self):
        for supplied in ("", "."):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_rejects_target_that_resolves_to_root(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "a/..")

    def test_rejects_traversal_to_sibling(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../root-sibling/secret.txt")

    def test_rejects_traversal_to_sibling_with_shared_name_prefix(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../root-sibling/new.txt")

    def test_rejects_traversal_hidden_behind_nonexistent_component(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "missing/../../root-sibling/x.txt")

    def test_rejects_symlink_to_outside_directory(self):
        self.symlink(self.root / "out", self.sibling)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "out/secret.txt")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "out/new.txt")

    def test_rejects_symlink_to_outside_file(self):
        self.symlink(self.root / "link.txt", self.sibling / "secret.txt")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "link.txt")

    def test_rejects_dangling_symlink_pointing_outside(self):
        self.symlink(self.root / "dangling", self.tmp / "nowhere.txt")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "dangling")

    def test_rejects_symlink_to_root_itself(self):
        self.symlink(self.root / "self", self.root)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "self")

    def test_accepts_symlink_that_stays_inside_root(self):
        self.symlink(self.root / "alias.txt", self.root / "existing.txt")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "alias.txt"), self.root / "existing.txt")

    def test_root_given_through_symlink_is_resolved(self):
        link_root = self.tmp / "root-link"
        self.symlink(link_root, self.root)
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(link_root, "x.txt"), self.root / "x.txt")

    def test_missing_root_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(FileNotFoundError):
            resolve_upload(self.tmp / "does-not-exist", "x.txt")

    def test_symlink_loop_raises_value_error(self):
        self.symlink(self.root / "loop", self.root / "loop")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "loop")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

        for supplied in ("", ".", "nested/.."):

        tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(tmp.cleanup)
        base = Path(tmp.name).resolve()
        self.root = base / "root"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.sibling = base / "root_evil"
        self.sibling.mkdir()
        self.secret = self.sibling / "secret.txt"
        self.secret.write_text("secret")

    def test_nested_nonexistent_path_is_inside_root_and_not_created(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/new.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "a" / "b" / "new.txt")
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "a").exists())

    def test_existing_file_inside_root(self):
        (self.root / "f.txt").write_text("ok")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "f.txt"), self.root / "f.txt")

    def test_absolute_path_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.secret))

    def test_root_itself_rejected(self):
        for supplied in ("", ".", "a/.."):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_traversal_to_sibling_rejected(self):
        for supplied in ("../root_evil/secret.txt", "../root_evil/new.txt", "a/../../root_evil/x"):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_symlink_directory_to_sibling_rejected(self):

            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_symlink_file_to_sibling_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.secret, self.root / "file_link")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "file_link")

    def test_dangling_symlink_to_outside_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "missing.txt", self.root / "dangling")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "dangling")

    def test_symlink_inside_root_allowed(self):
        real = self.root / "real"
        real.mkdir()
        os.symlink(real, self.root / "alias")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "alias/f.txt"), real / "f.txt")

    def test_root_given_as_symlink_is_resolved(self):
        root_link = self.root.parent / "root_link"
        os.symlink(self.root, root_link)
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(root_link, "a.txt"), self.root / "a.txt")

        )

        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):

import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import resolve_upload  # noqa: E402


class ResolveUploadTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self._tmp.cleanup)
        base = Path(self._tmp.name).resolve()
        self.root = base / "root"
        self.sibling = base / "root-sibling"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.sibling.mkdir()

    def test_simple_name_inside_root(self):
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "file.txt"), self.root / "file.txt")

    def test_nested_nonexistent_path_inside_root(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/c.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "a" / "b" / "c.txt")
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "a").exists())

    def test_does_not_create_files(self):
        resolve_upload(self.root, "new/dir/file.txt")
        self.assertEqual(list(self.root.iterdir()), [])

    def test_dot_segments_normalized_inside_root(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            resolve_upload(self.root, "a/../b.txt"), self.root / "b.txt"
        )

    def test_rejects_absolute_path(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.root / "file.txt"))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "/etc/passwd")

    def test_rejects_root_itself(self):
        for supplied in (".", "", "a/.."):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_rejects_parent_traversal(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../x.txt")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "a/../../x.txt")

    def test_rejects_sibling_with_shared_prefix(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../root-sibling/file.txt")

    def test_rejects_sibling_directory_via_traversal(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../root-sibling")

    def test_rejects_symlink_to_outside_directory(self):
        link = self.root / "link"
        os.symlink(self.sibling, link, target_is_directory=True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "link/file.txt")

    def test_rejects_symlink_to_outside_file(self):
        outside = self.sibling / "secret.txt"
        outside.write_text("secret")
        os.symlink(outside, self.root / "alias.txt")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "alias.txt")

    def test_rejects_symlink_pointing_at_root_parent(self):
        os.symlink(self.root.parent, self.root / "up", target_is_directory=True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "up/root/file.txt")

    def test_accepts_symlink_that_stays_inside_root(self):
        real = self.root / "real"
        real.mkdir()
        os.symlink(real, self.root / "alias", target_is_directory=True)
        self.assertEqual(
            resolve_upload(self.root, "alias/file.txt"), real / "file.txt"
        )

    def test_accepts_root_given_through_symlink(self):
        link_root = self.root.parent / "root-link"
        os.symlink(self.root, link_root, target_is_directory=True)
        self.assertEqual(
            resolve_upload(link_root, "file.txt"), self.root / "file.txt"
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
